result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales-rep list uses.

The change is in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I replaced the `ORDER BY` with the same `CASE` expression the sales-rep query uses, and updated its Javadoc to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before.

`RegionManagerTest` and `TicketsPerProductTest` pass (7 tests, offline). Neither test checks the ticket order directly, so I did not run the T-1…T-5 example from the task. Nothing is committed.
